## Welcome

Welcome to the **Slidecrafting** workshop at [LatinR 2026](https://latinr.org/)! Over the next three hours, in person, we will learn how to craft functional and aesthetically pleasing slides using [Quarto](https://quarto.org/) reveal.js presentations.

::: {.callout-note}
This workshop is a hands-on companion to the [Slidecrafting book](https://slidecrafting-book.com).
:::

## Logistics

- **When:** Wednesday 11 November 2026, morning tutorial block (8:30 to 12:00)
- **Where:** Universidad de Antioquia, Medellín, Colombia (check the [LatinR site](https://latinr.org/) for your room)
- **Language:** English
- **Bring:** a laptop with the [setup](setup.qmd) steps done, and its charger

## What you will learn

- How a reveal.js `.qmd` file is put together, and the YAML options worth knowing
- How to theme slides with sass variables for fonts, colors, and sizes
- How to position elements on a slide and modify the standard ones
- How to use fragments, write your own, and match elements with auto-animate
- How to install and use Quarto reveal.js extensions

## Before you arrive

Please complete the [setup](setup.qmd) steps **before** the workshop. Conference wifi can be slow when a room full of people downloads at once, so install and clone ahead of time.
